skills: Press again after a Defensive Assist: she stays on-field and strikes for Wind DMG (counts as a Basic Attack).
Parries for massive Daze; uses fewer Assist Points under heavy attack.
Forgive Me for Not Seeing You Off

After Kindly Rest in Peace, fires on its own once Eyes of the Storm plus her Wind Energy total 3+: a hammer throw for Wind DMG that detonates up to 3 Eyes into Miniature Windstorms, or one Giant Windstorm if 3 go at once.
Slide for Wind DMG; hold during it for Whirlwind, a steerable tornado that drains Energy and hits along its path. Ends into Kindly Rest in Peace.
Spends all Wind Energy on a wind cannon for Wind DMG, plus an extra hit and one Eye of the Storm per point.
Lasts 30s then detonates (max 9; extras pop the oldest). Each detonation blasts nearby enemies for Wind DMG.
Powerful strike for massive Wind DMG.
Wide strike for massive Wind DMG; +1 Wind Energy.

core.name: Warm Night's Embrace
core.text:
Every 25 Energy spent gives 1 Wind Energy (max 3). Each 0.01 initial Energy Regen above 1.2 gives +5 ATK (max 560) and +0.4 Impact (max 46).
Forgive Me for Not Seeing You Off on a Windswept enemy triggers Cleanse, turning Contamination back to its original Anomaly.
When anyone triggers Contamination or Cleanse, the squad gets a 50s buff for that attribute and Wind: per 1% of her CRIT Rate, +0.4% CRIT DMG (max 25%), or +0.2% Laceration DMG for Armorer Agents (max 11.5%). Re-applying Windswept also grants it for the overwritten attribute.

ability.name: Porcelloy Heart
ability.text: +8% DMG, +1.2% per level (max 80%). Squad hits raise the enemy's Stun DMG Multiplier by 30% and add 2s to its Stun. Squad-applied Windswept enemies take 8% more direct Wind DMG and DMG of the Contamination's attribute, and Windswept lasts 20s longer. Enters battle with 40 Energy (once per 180s in Investigation Zones). EX Special gives +30% Anomaly Buildup Rate for 50s.

mindscapes: Kindly Rest in Peace lowers All-Attribute RES by 15% for 50s. +40% CRIT DMG.

Don't Catch a Chill deals 5% more Daze and raises the enemy's Stun DMG Multiplier by 30% until it recovers. Each Eye detonated gives Windflow (max 3); switching out in Whirlwind spends them to keep it going 0.2s each without Energy.
Defensive Assist parries give 1 Energy and Dodge Counter hits 2 (once per use). Ultimate deals +20% DMG and +10% Daze.
Ignores 15% Wind RES. A Giant Windstorm applies Afterecho: 2 more Giant Windstorms on the target, one every 3s (stacks). Giant Windstorms deal 250% DMG and +20% Daze.
